blocks.text: Vendors must complete a security questionnaire administered by the Vendor Risk team. A score of 80 or above passes the vendor directly to contract negotiation. A score between 60 and 79 requires a compensating controls review before the vendor may proceed to contract. A score below 60 results in immediate rejection of the vendor.
Vendors that handle personally identifiable information (PII) must execute a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with Legal before any contract is countersigned.
The Procurement team issues the vendor contract for signature only after all required reviews and agreements are complete.

messages.text: Effective immediately, the passing threshold for direct contract has been raised from 80 to 85. Vendors scoring 80 to 84 must now go through the compensating controls review path.
